Don't do this if you're a stickler for tracking information as your expected shipping date will not match your actual delivery date. I've been doing this trick for the last two or three years and have had a handful or so of packages delivered before their expected shipping date because they had been accidentally expedited.
LPT: When ordering online, click through all of your options (if you're getting standard/free shipping). You may just get your package delivered via expedited shipping!

Totally. As you're checking out, you'll have the options to choose your shipping. There's usually only three options, but you may have more. For this example I'll do...

*Super slow mule shipping. (4-6 weeks) - free

*Standard shipping (4-6 days) - $4

*2 day shipping - $15

*1 day shipping - $25

In this scenario, I'm wanting to select standard shipping for $4. This way I know, no matter what, I'll get it within 4-6 days.

I'll select the 2 day shipping first and let the site update my information to show my new total. Then I'll click on 1 day shipping, check the total. Then I may go back to 2 day shipping, check the total, and then finally, go back to my standard shipping option. Waiting for my total to refresh again, making sure that it's most def selected standard shipping so I won't get billed more.

Granted, it's not a reliable life hack, but it's a nice one to have in your back pocket. I actually just ordered in something I really needed, but couldn't afford the expedited shipping. Did this, and instead of arriving two weeks from the order date, like it was suppose to, I got it in yesterday. Two days after my order with "Priority shipping" written on the box in pen.
